<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
$reader = new class {
    public function __get(?string $incoming): ARRAY {
        echo $incoming, ":";
        if ($incoming === "empty") { return []; }
        if ($incoming === "bad") { return 13; }
        return [2 => true, "label" => "ok", 0 => 7];
    }
};
$selector = "bag";
$destination = 42;
echo $reader->empty === [] ? "EMPTY;" : "BAD_EMPTY;";
echo $reader->$selector === [2 => true, "label" => "ok", 0 => 7] ? "ARRAY;" : "BAD_ARRAY;";
$reader->drop;
echo "DROP;";
try { $destination = $reader->bad === []; }
catch (TypeError $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $selector === "bag" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
$cell = 1;
$held = [&$cell, "plain" => 7];
function alterReturnedArray() {
    global $held, $cell;
    $held["plain"] = 8;
    $cell = 2;
    return [2, "plain" => 7];
}
$reader = new class {
    public function __get(mixed $incoming): mixed {
        global $held;
        echo "GET;";
        return $held;
    }
};
$destination = $reader->value === alterReturnedArray();
echo $destination === true ? "SNAPSHOT;" : "BAD_SNAPSHOT;";
echo $held["plain"] === 8 ? "COW;" : "BAD_COW;";
echo $cell === 2 ? "REF;" : "BAD_REF;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class ArrayReviewPayload {
    public function __destruct() { echo "PAYLOAD;"; }
}
$payload = new ArrayReviewPayload;
$reader = new class {
    public function __get(string $incoming): array {
        global $reader, $payload;
        echo "GET;";
        $items = [$payload];
        $payload = null;
        $reader = null;
        return $items;
    }
    public function __destruct() {
        echo "RECEIVER;";
        throw new Exception("receiver-array");
    }
};
try { $reader->gone; }
catch (Exception $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; }
echo $reader === null ? "CLEARED;" : "BAD_RECEIVER;";
echo "DONE;";
